title: EP 4 — PLAN MODE
sub: See the plan before Claude touches a single file
lines: Let Claude rewrite half your codebase... unsupervised?
Letting Clawd rewrite half your codebase, unsupervised? There's a safer way.
Plan mode: see the plan before any file changes
Plan mode lets you see the whole plan, before a single file changes.
Shift+Tab to cycle into plan mode
Just press Shift Tab to cycle into plan mode.
Ask for the refactor — Claude only reads, never edits
Ask for your refactor, and Clawd only reads your code, it never edits.
You get a numbered, step-by-step plan
Seconds later, you get a clear, numbered, step by step plan.
Ctrl+G to tweak the plan in your editor
Want a tweak? Press Control G, and edit the plan right in your editor.
Approve — then it executes exactly that
Approve, and Clawd executes exactly that, no surprises on the big stuff.
Stay in control of every real change
You stay in full control of every real change to your code.
